Greek passages copied from a small, rough print; the accents and several letters in the lines marked [?] are doubtful, notably the opening Greek of the first two glosses, the word after "λογισμὸς &", and the long Greek line at the end, which is only partly legible. The Greek in "Θρέψε" and "Οὐ κατ'" is doubtful. Verse lines are copied as printed; "acrisium" is read as printed. Printing error suspected: "Hebenvxorem" (for Hebe uxorem) left as printed; "Nocturnis" and the verse of the Ovid line are read from a rough scan. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot, with the page ending "signi-", continued on the next page.
